what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Chile in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 23057 asylum seekers from Chile.
The United States hosts the largest share, 59.6%, followed by Mexico, Canada and Spain.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Chile, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 159 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 24434, at the end of 2024 and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from Chile are counted separately.
